fusions.name: Apex Chop
fusions.desc: You leap to a target up to 7 tiles away and chop down for 15 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Felling Circle
fusions.desc: You jump and swing the axe in a full circle, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Long Haft
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Weight of the Drop
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover raises your physical damage by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
